headline: Cite the object, not the machinery.
purpose: Public citations should help a reader inspect evidence, intellectual inheritance, comparison, or a named source. Internal provenance remains recorded for reconstructibility without being repeated as reader-facing citation furniture.
rules: Cite external factual, formal, legal, scientific, or historical claims when the source materially helps a reader evaluate the claim.
Name foundational or neighboring work when intellectual inheritance, comparison, or non-equivalence matters.
Link a named Boundary First document or artifact when the reader can inspect the object itself.
Do not expose projection ids, schema versions, hashes, migration notes, raw source paths, or other internal provenance machinery as public citations.
A citation supplies traceability; it does not raise a claim's maturity, authority, or evidence status.
When support is weaker than the claim, lower the claim rather than adding citation clutter.

meaning: Established theory or method that supplies part of the intellectual inheritance.
A source used to compare mechanisms, primitives, questions, or operating assumptions.
A current organization or community working in a meaningfully adjacent problem space.
A source bearing directly on a factual, empirical, legal, mathematical, or historical claim.
A competing framing or result retained because disagreement helps bound the BFL claim.
A recognized unresolved question used to locate a research problem without implying that BFL has solved it.

title: How we bind our own work
lead: The doctrine governs the laboratory before it governs anyone else.
commitments: Represent affected parties and residual burdens.
Give consequential decisions meaningful contest and appeal.
Give repair an owner with capacity.
Version material changes and preserve rationale.
Build stewardship and retirement before uncontrolled scale.
governance.humaneTest: Would you put your family inside this system?

headline: Challenge something we published.
body: If you think a Boundary First Labs claim, policy, record, or representation is wrong, incomplete, unfair, misleading, or missing a consequential distinction, we want a durable route for that criticism to land.

publicPosition: The work is substantial. The durable multi-person institution around it is still being built.
notYetClaimed: independent multi-person governance at mature scale
nearTermInstitutionalGoal: Turn accumulated work into publicly useful, bounded, inspectable forms while building the criticism, maintenance, stewardship, and governance structures required to support them.
longTermInstitutionalGoal: Become a durable public-interest steward capable of surviving correction, disagreement, transfer, and succession.
